notes.title: 1.5.9 Lust Improvements
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

- Lust has been changed to be an upfront cost instead per shoot. This should make it more clear how much lust you need per encounter.
- Balance on early game characters, should be easier to progress and more intuitive overall.
- A pack has been added to the store to boost your currencies if you want extremely easy progression.
- Helpful messages have been added to some actions to show you what you need to do.
- Visual bug fixes

We think we are coming close to finalizing our progression balance and we can focus back on content next! Let us know what you think about the new way Lust is handled!

notes.title: Let FREE-dom Ring!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/606b1fbcd270ee6ab5b501204dce0a4e3f1a8b6b.png[/img]
Our original $2 price point created more problems than ease for me and my teammate, so we've decided to just welcome everyone overboard! [b]In preparation for the next chapter of Girls Overboard, we will be going free2play[/b] in order to welcome as many new players as possible. [b]What is the next chapter???[/b] Well, this is where you come in... 

[h3][b]What type of content would you like to see in future updates? [/b][/h3]
New girls? More content of the current girls? Seasonal Events? Girls crossing over from other games? The sky is the limit for our imagination, so don't hold back! Or should I say, our degeneracy has no floor? Either way, you get it. We want to add more boobs, more butts, and more lewd stuff!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240
And speaking of butts, if you enjoyed the latest character, Eleanna the elf, you will be happy to hear she will have her very own VN coming soon, [b]Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf![/b] Well, technically she has to share the VN with her rival, but still, Wishlist today so you are notified the moment Eleanna's panties drop-- I mean, Eleanna's game drops!!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/2274f3df99dc787e84104f07c3959f802206e558.jpg[/img]
We wanted a way for[b] players that missed the limited time Halloween Event [/b]to be able to experience it, so the unlockable content is now available for purchase in the shop! This includes [b]3 story scenes with Miya and 10 Five-Star Halloween outfits.[/b] Unlock seasonal event content free by playing them while they are live!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/b38d3f066832fa987d6b6fb01f5e469682b4ab0c.jpg[/img]
[b]Get notified when events go live and get other rewards[/b] such as secret outfits, wallpaper packs and other in-game rewards by signing up for the AGL Newsletter on our website: https://AGLstudioArt.com



Thank you for playing Girls Overboard! The price change will happen next week. We hope you had a merry Christmas and we wish you a happy new year!
-Din

notes.title: 1.5.3 Bug fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Here are some changes since 1.5.2 :)

- The lag spike on the bubble shooter during character swap has been reduced.
- All girls now appear during bubble shooter even when locked & maxed but it will notify you of their state. This is done for clarity to see which characters you have completed.
- Stage 7/8 bug where the game stops working has been fixed (One of the optional levels in this stage was broken)

Let us know if you find any more issues!

notes.title: Title Update 5: New Gameplay, New Character!
notes.content:
For the past few months we've been listening to you, the player's feedback. Both good and bad. Your opinion means a lot to us, so we have been working between Free Title Updates on creating an entirely new gameplay experience. We referenced games you suggested as well as added our own touch to set Girls Overboard apart. We hope you enjoy!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/c313a6f650497c63402bef27860cb96bc080e788.jpg[/img]

[b]Eleanna from Faulty Apprentice is here![/b]
Eleanna is a Sailing Instructor looking for an apprentice willing to learn, and most importantly, not a pervert. If you can keep your pants on, learning to sail should be a breeze. There's no way you would end up in international waters with her tied up and unconscious, right?

Whether you're a Stars Reach veteran or have never played our flagship game, Faulty Apprentice, you are in for an exciting experience with the newest addition to Girls Overboard, Eleanna! She's also the star of our upcoming game, Best Elf! Now available to wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240
https://store.steampowered.com/app/630550

[b]New Bubble Shooter![/b]
Prevent girls from overwhelming you with their sexuality by shooting gems of the same color as they descend and destroying them. Destroying gems and using Lust will determine how quickly your relationships increase or if you will fail in miserable loneliness.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/46f8525f7aa7bebc02ec11dee494a6c6f4fa33fd.png[/img]

[b]New Relationship System and other mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Hearts <3 Unlock Hearts and story scenes for each girl by filling their Relationship Bar via the Bubble Shooter. Failing to clear character stages in time will reset the progress, so don't miss your chance to shoot your shot! 
[*] Lust! Gems, Gifts, and Dust have been streamlined into a single currency, Lust! Lust points can be used to increase the speed at which Relationships increase. The more you Lust, the more you bust! 
[*] Look! I mean, Loot! The Fashion Boutique is now optional loot that spawns when you successfully win a girl's Heart. Like real clothes though, you get what you pay for!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/614dfd4e10f5ffa493680724926af1cc2f5d620e.jpg[/img]

Body Writing Outfit Bundle 2!
Enjoy the popular Body Writing outfits for all the new girls, Talia, Madison, Ashera, and Eleanna! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/215e6733fdcf161844a7ad761ab664637579bfea.jpg[/img]

If the other outfits aren't lewd enough for you, then this one should do the trick. Make Eleanna your personal maid, sit and wait for your entrance as king of her castle!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/2845909e5064a7d4d07beddc0296a1218ce55e62.jpg[/img]

Merry Christmas! Get in the Christmas spirit by getting all eleven girls into sexy Christmas outfits! 


While we are pretty happy with the direction of the game, we will continue to keep an eye on the progression numbers and player feedback to smoothen the new experience. So, don't be shy to reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/aglstudioart]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/AGLstudioArt]Twitter[/url] or right here on Steam. We appreciate you playing our games and want to give you the most enjoyable experience possible! 

Thank you for playing Girls Overboard. (= 
-Din

notes.title: Title Update 4: Halloween Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/3f87541f575e9ce4c79c0bf4fc46625d9c21ddbb.jpg[/img]

It's Halloween night, you and Miya are alone, and there is an exclusive costume party on the North Shore. [b]All you have to do is get there..[/b] Are you and Miya be in for a trick or a treat? [b]This limited time event is FREE to play![/b] Collect pumpkin tickets in the slot machine to unlock a spooktacular story for Miya. Complete all three parts and [b]earn an exclusive 5 Star outfit for Miya[/b] and enjoy a fully animated climax to the story. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/fe3dbfb0969f17ced42abda5448d26997ab2249b.jpg[/img]

New 5-Star Outfits for all 10 girls! Use Pumpkin Tickets to buy [b]Limited Time Witch Outfits[/b], not just for the base 7 girls, but also the last 3 update girls, Talia (Future Fragments), Madison and Ashera! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/c7ae6932f471b01947ab3e9254569f3c488e9a26.jpg[/img]

[b]New character coming for Free Title Update 5![/b] Some of you may recognize this character based on her silhouette, some of you may be meeting her for the first time, but either way, you are in for a real treat (=

Speaking of treats, we also have a [b]complete revamp to the gameplay coming[/b]. I can't say anything specific right now, but we have been [b]listening to player feedback and are working hard to make a more enjoyable gameplay experience for you[/b]. Thanks for bearing with us until then!


[b]Comment[/b] to let us know what you thought of this update, [b]leave us a review[/b] if you haven't already, and above all.. [b]HAPPY HALLOWEEN!! =D[/b]
-Din

notes.title: Title Update 1: Futuristic Fantasy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/59896287e064ad48a25d9014f6134e77d442c0da.png[/img]

[h1]New Character: Talia from Future Fragments![/h1]
Are you ready for an action-packed, time-warping, super sexy adventure? Then our newest addition to the datable roster is for you! Talia from Future Fragments had a teleportation malfunction and needs your help getting back to her world! Talia's story was co-written by the creator of Future Fragments, HentaiWriter, so if you are already a fan of FF you can expect an authentic Talia experience to enjoy in the meantime. If you are not familiar with Future Fragments, then you're in for double the surprises!

[h2]New Slot Machine [/h2]
The slot machine told us rewards to dole out slowly, so we said, NO! The slot machine told us to flood your box with gems, so we said, NO! The slot even told us using bait was dumb, so we said, NO! You told us to make it better, so we said, NO! Wait, no, to that we said YES! The slot machine has been completely revamped and streamlined to provide a better experience for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/7760319eb1fd015b34ae219c6e8871e8fa04d771.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/972d1955e30eea0a4e5085b15f6d4949ab3b7d7c.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Outfit Bundles![/h2]
We will be adding special outfit bundles to the shop that include outfit for each of the base 7 girls. These outfits are five-star rating so you must have the FREE 18+ Wet 'n' Wild patch to enjoy them.

[h3]Other Small Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prototype Net is now purchasable with Sand Dollars
[*] A small amount of exp will be gained even without winning in slot machine
[*] Other balancing changes
[/list]

notes.title: First Patch Update + Upcoming FREE Title Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes Ahoy!!! All sailors on deck!!![/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements. Achievements should trigger properly now.
[*] Slot Machine lag spikes have been reduced.
[*] NSFW setting: No longer resets each time loading game.
[*] Screen cropping of girls under certain resolutions
[/list]

[h3]Balancing/Edits:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Match 3 gives more dust on larger matches.
[*] Outfits UI clarification: UI added to make clear that Outfits can be bought with free OR premium currency.
[*] Gems and progression. *We will keep looking at numbers so the game can be completed in a fair amount of time but also not overload players with useless currency
[/list]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] More Music and button available to change songs!
[*] Full screen Girl/Outfit preview in character screen!
[/list]

[h3]Reward Codes:[/h3] 
As thank you to everyone that played the original demo and was part of our Wishlist Campaign, we have some bonus rewards to help win your waifus hearts! 
-Use code: [b]"3wishes"[/b] to unlock 300 Sand Dollars, 10 dust of each color, 1 Fresh Water!
-Use code: [b]"dontforgetthedemo"[/b] to unlock 100 Sand Dollars, 5 dust of each color, 1 Fresh Water!


[h3]First FREE Title Update Coming:[/h3]
The first addition to the Datable Roster will be, Talia, a crossover from the upcoming game Future Fragments!

[previewyoutube=KDQTSrn9Yg0;full][/previewyoutube]

Mahalo to everyone for playing Girls Overboard! Feel free to join us on our official Discord Server at [url=https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt]https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt[/url]

Aloha!
-Din
